stem:
Rohit has a mixture of heavier peanuts and their light removed skins. He stands outdoors near a running fan that blows air across a tray.

When can winnowing work for this mixture?

options.text: When moving air carries the light skins farther while the heavier peanuts fall closer.
When he closes the room and switches the fan off so there is no moving air.
When the heavier peanuts travel farther in the air and the light skins fall closer.
When the skins and peanuts are the same mass but painted different colours.

teacher.key_rationale: Winnowing needs moving air so lighter skins travel farther and heavier peanuts fall closer. No air, reversing which part travels farther, or colour-only separation miss the method.
